brief: A 12-second explainer with no words at all: a seed is planted, watered, grows into a tree, and the tree drops a new seed. Shapes and motion only.
notes: The scene sat dead-still from ~1.2 s to the first water drop at 3.2 s, and almost everything entered with the same bouncy back.out pop (plus three identical slide drops), so there was no lead and far more overshoot than allowed. I added a slow drift to the seed through 1.3-3.2 s to keep the opening alive, kept the single spring on the hero main canopy while softening the mound, seed landing and leaves and giving the two side canopies quiet varied-timing zoom entrances, and varied the three water drops' timing, distance and blur for an uneven rhythm.
